notes: TORQUE-BALANCED ZERO-SPEED EQUILIBRIUM (a different case from the locked shaft). Supply chosen so the stall torque exactly carries the weight: K i = tau with i = V/R_tot, so V = R_tot tau / K = 2.05 x 0.0392266 / 0.3 = 0.2680485 V and i = 0.130757 A. The switch closes at 20 ms with the brake held; the current settles (L/R = 2.44 ms); the brake is RELEASED at 50 ms and the free shaft stays at zero speed because the torques balance — the brake then carries no torque at all (before release it carried only tau - K i, which is also ~0). Steady speed from the algebra: w_ss = (K V - R tau)/(K^2 + R b) ~ +2e-7 rad/s.
